prompt: This is a bounded LTZZZ-owned public task under original task DEEP-SUPERAGENT-20261103. Context: an internal review queue holds many items in a 'submitted, pending independent review' state, and a separate oversight log holds many open warnings. Both are internal and must NOT be sent to an external model, so you are given only a fictional, sanitized sample. Public sample of pending-review items, each with: id, age_days, evidence_sha_present (true/false), independent_reviewer_assigned (true/false), reviewer_seat_available (true/false). Items: Q01 age 23 days, sha true, reviewer true, seat false. Q02 age 23, sha true, reviewer true, seat true. Q03 age 14, sha false, reviewer true, seat true. Q04 age 9, sha true, reviewer false, seat true. Q05 age 3, sha true, reviewer true, seat true. Q06 age 1, sha true, reviewer true, seat false. Public sample of oversight warnings: W01 has a later superseding record. W02 has no evidence path recorded. W03 cites an evidence path that does not exist. W04 was already closed by a later stage. W05 has evidence and no superseding record. Task: design a deterministic triage ruleset that maps each item to exactly one reason code and one recommended next action. Allowed reason codes are missing_independent_reviewer, evidence_sha_mismatch, reviewer_seat_unavailable, duplicate_of_closed_task, needs_real_model_call, superseded_by_later_record, evidence_path_missing. Produce a decision table covering Q01-Q06 and W01-W05, state which rule fired first for each, and explicitly say which items must escalate to a human decision seat rather than being auto-closed. State clearly that a green queue check or a health HTTP 200 is an ops_probe and must never be recorded as business completion, and that closing an item requires an independently verifiable side effect rather than a status label. Return concise JSON: rules in evaluation order, the decision table, escalation list, and the ops_probe rule. Do not claim any real internal item was reviewed, closed or reclassified; this task covers fictional samples only. Preserve task/package IDs and do not repeat a provider request after an unknown result.
